searchText: hey quick question i'm looking to see what validators are registered with a specific relay looking at the Relay API spec docs (https://flashbots.notion.site/Relay-API-Spec-5fb0819366954962bc02e81cb33840f5) i can see there is a GET /relay/v1/builder/validators this returns a list of validator registrations for the current and next epoch. i tried this endpoint on https://builder-relay-ropsten.flashbots.net/relay/v1/builder/validators and got a 403. Is it permissioned currently / is this the correct endpoint? if it's the correct endpoint is there a way to get access or if it's the wrong endpoint is there an endpoint on the relay that provides this information? Thanks for any help Hi all Thanks for the invite <@486501030046203915> Just deleted some posts- need more thought it all looks ok… not sure about the details and it’s possible that endpoint is not implemented for that relay yet well it's in `unstable` but yeah, not released it's on the branch that's headed for next release though hey thanks for the response just to double check when you visit https://builder-relay-ropsten.flashbots.net/relay/v1/builder/validators on chrome or curl https://builder-relay-ropsten.flashbots.net/relay/v1/builder/validators you get data back? attached an image of what i'm getting thanks same i would guess this endpoint is not live on that server yet PR to introduce a spec for the "circuit breaker" idea discussed on the last CL call https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/pull/47

hey quick question i'm looking to see what validators are registered with a specific relay 

looking at the Relay API spec docs (https://flashbots.notion.site/Relay-API-Spec-5fb0819366954962bc02e81cb33840f5) i can see there is a GET /relay/v1/builder/validators 

this returns a list of validator registrations for the current and next epoch. 

i tried this endpoint on https://builder-relay-ropsten.flashbots.net/relay/v1/builder/validators and got a 403. Is it permissioned currently / is this the correct endpoint?

if it's the correct endpoint is there a way to get access or if it's the wrong endpoint is there an endpoint on the relay that provides this information?

Thanks for any help
